detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #4 Linux Mode A network persona reaches further than a User-Agent string. PH4NTXM's Linux mode prepares a linked hardware identity, bounded Linux-oriented TCP/IP settings, and a wrapped Firefox ESR profile. Supported IP traffic passes through the Packet Transformation Engine, with an additional guard at physical egress. DHCP uses Linux-aligned client settings. Local Unbound forwards DNS through authenticated DNS-over-TLS. Network Drift and Ghost Stack add their normal-mode behavior, while Boot Pilot exposes protection readiness before its browser action launches the session's browser. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
